name: @ozperium/agentspec
description: Testing framework for AI agents — Jest for non-deterministic AI behavior

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/test-runner-latency.cjs && node scripts/test-contract-hardening.cjs && node scripts/test-adapters.cjs && node scripts/test-workflow.cjs && node scripts/test-runner-selection.cjs && node scripts/test-cli.cjs && node scripts/test-watch.cjs && node scripts/test-action.cjs && node dist/cli.js run --dir tests --mock --ci
scripts.test:judge: npm run build && node dist/cli.js run --dir integration-tests --mock --ci
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run test:conformance && npm run test:package

author: Ozperium
